{"source": "import cadquery as cq
def make_center_stage(stage_size: float, height: float) -> cq.Workplane:
    """Create the square center stage.
    Args:
        stage_size: Side length of the center square stage.
        height: Height of the center stage.
    Returns:
        A CadQuery solid for the center stage.
    """
    return (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(stage_size, stage_size)
        .extrude(height)
    )
def make_x_ramp(
    x_start: float,
    x_end: float,
    y_min: float,
    y_max: float,
    inner_height: float,
    inner_on_left: bool,
) -> cq.Workplane:
    """Create a ramp whose slope changes along the X direction.
    Args:
        x_start: Start x-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        x_end: End x-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        y_min: Minimum y-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        y_max: Maximum y-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        inner_height: Height at the side connected to the center stage.
        inner_on_left: True if the higher side is at x_start, otherwise at x_end.
    Returns:
        A CadQuery solid for one X-direction ramp.
    """
    if inner_on_left:
        profile = [
            (x_start, 0.0),
            (x_end, 0.0),
            (x_start, inner_height),
        ]
    else:
        profile = [
            (x_start, 0.0),
            (x_end, 0.0),
            (x_end, inner_height),
        ]
    return (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .workplane(offset=y_min)
        .polyline(profile)
        .close()
        .extrude(y_max - y_min)
    )
def make_y_ramp(
    y_start: float,
    y_end: float,
    x_min: float,
    x_max: float,
    inner_height: float,
    inner_on_bottom: bool,
) -> cq.Workplane:
    """Create a ramp whose slope changes along the Y direction.
    Args:
        y_start: Start y-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        y_end: End y-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        x_min: Minimum x-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        x_max: Maximum x-coordinate of the ramp footprint.
        inner_height: Height at the side connected to the center stage.
        inner_on_bottom: True if the higher side is at y_start, otherwise at y_end.
    Returns:
        A CadQuery solid for one Y-direction ramp.
    """
    if inner_on_bottom:
        profile = [
            (y_start, 0.0),
            (y_end, 0.0),
            (y_start, inner_height),
        ]
    else:
        profile = [
            (y_start, 0.0),
            (y_end, 0.0),
            (y_end, inner_height),
        ]
    return (
        cq.Workplane("YZ")
        .workplane(offset=x_min)
        .polyline(profile)
        .close()
        .extrude(x_max - x_min)
    )
arm_width = 21.92
arm_length = 16.44
thickness = 7.4
half_stage = arm_width / 2.0
outer_extent = half_stage + arm_length
center_stage = make_center_stage(arm_width, thickness)
right_ramp = make_x_ramp(
    x_start=half_stage,
    x_end=outer_extent,
    y_min=-half_stage,
    y_max=half_stage,
    inner_height=thickness,
    inner_on_left=True,
)
left_ramp = make_x_ramp(
    x_start=-outer_extent,
    x_end=-half_stage,
    y_min=-half_stage,
    y_max=half_stage,
    inner_height=thickness,
    inner_on_left=False,
)
top_ramp = make_y_ramp(
    y_start=half_stage,
    y_end=outer_extent,
    x_min=-half_stage,
    x_max=half_stage,
    inner_height=thickness,
    inner_on_bottom=True,
)
bottom_ramp = make_y_ramp(
    y_start=-outer_extent,
    y_end=-half_stage,
    x_min=-half_stage,
    x_max=half_stage,
    inner_height=thickness,
    inner_on_bottom=False,
)
result = (
    center_stage
    .union(right_ramp)
    .union(left_ramp)
    .union(top_ramp)
    .union(bottom_ramp)
)
